messages:
alyssa: kicking off phased rollout v3.2.1 -> 5% now, planned increments to 25% over 30m. change window 22:00-23:00 PT. targets: default, edge-eu.
deploy-bot: @alyssa started rollout id=r-4524; mode=staged; step_percent=5; current=5%; details: https://deploy.internal/r/4524 :rocket:
ben_platform: tagging release artifacts and updating dashboards. I'll post short release notes after this sync.
carmen_sre: quick observation: eu-west-1 p95 +110ms in the last 6m vs baseline. sample size small (n~50) but flagging.
devin_ops: can you share the trace query so I can correlate with infra metrics?
carmen_sre: query: `SELECT p95_latency FROM traces WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND service='inference' AND since=now()-6m`
devin_ops: running it now. seeing two hosts with GC spikes around the same timestamps on gcp-eu-03, also some cpu steal.
alyssa: decision time 1: do we 1) pause at 5% and pin eu-west to v3.2.0, 2) continue to 10% and watch, or 3) rollback globally to v3.2.0?
ben_platform: my read: hold at 5% and pin region for safety. don't roll back globally unless we see error escalation.
carmen_sre: +1 hold & pin eu-west.
devin_ops: +1. I'll queue a targeted warmup and evict suspicious KV cache entries on gcp-eu-03.
alyssa: quick reaction vote: +1 hold+pin eu-west, -1 continue to 10%.
ben_platform: +1.
carmen_sre: +1.
devin_ops: +1.
alyssa: consensus = hold. executing regional pin now. deploy-bot: pausing rollout r-4524 at percent=5, note="hold: eu-west p95 increase; apply regional pin"; action=pauser-891
deploy-bot: region pin set: eu-west-1 -> v3.2.0 (traffic diverted to pinned version).
devin_ops: confirming no global rollback. scheduling warmup job on gcp-eu-03 and monitoring GC windows.
carmen_sre: monitoring p95, 5xx rates, and retracing samples. will escalate if rates breach thresholds.
ben_platform: leaving ramp gating in place for 10%->25% until signoff post-warmup.
alyssa: updating release notes and the change-log: note added about hold + eu-west pin. will reconvene in 20m for check-in. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout r-4524 status=paused, paused_by=alyssa, paused_at=4523679032, reason="eu-west latency spike"
alyssa: end of thread 1 — hold in effect. ping @here for any updates.
